instruction: The method name `get_command` on `Group` (src/click/core.py) should say that it looks a subcommand up by name. Rename `Group.get_command` to `lookup_command`. The rename must cover the base class, every subclass that overrides it, and every place that calls or refers to it, including tests. Leave comments, docstrings and other documentation text unchanged. Behavior must not change: the project must still work and its tests must pass.
